decision: The complete calibrated Cassini raster was inspected. This finest-distance candidate used CL1/CB3 with an 8.2 second exposure and shows elongated signals, not a reliable registered disc. The 2026 mission review independently inspects shorter exposures across seven filters: 4–6 pixels across, no unambiguous surface markings. Original camera pointing and an unmeasured three-dimensional shape do not qualify a terrain map from these frames.
disposition: Research only. Shape and photographic surface mapping remain unqualified; no standalone scene is included.
